questions.stem: The cardiovascular examination of a 21 y primigravida at term reveals a split S1, normal S2, S3 easily audible with a 2/6 systolic ejection murmur greater during inspiration and a mildly elevated JVP. You immediately recognize that:
questions.stemHtml: The cardiovascular examination of a 21 y primigravida at term reveals a split S1, normal S2, S3 easily audible with a 2/6 systolic ejection murmur greater during inspiration and a mildly elevated JVP. You immediately recognize that:

options.label: A
options.text: The presence of S3 is abnormal

options.label: B
options.text: The systolic murmur is unusual in a pregnant woman at term

options.label: C
options.text: The combination of a prominent S3 and an elevated JVP is suggestive of an underlying heart disease

options.label: D
options.text: All findings are normal changes of pregnancy
